trophies.label: Platinum Trophies
trophies.description: All trophies in GTA III Definitive Edition, including the platinum.
trophies.requirement: Earn all 29 trophies without using cheats.

storymissions.label: Story Missions
storymissions.description: Main story mission completions. Mission-start titles do not increment this counter.
storymissions.requirement: Complete all 50 main story missions required by the 100% checklist.

payphonemissions.label: Payphone Missions
payphonemissions.description: El Burro, Marty Chonks, King Courtney, and D-Ice mission chains.

hiddenpackages.label: Hidden Packages
hiddenpackages.description: Package popups show an authoritative current count that OCR can use to repair missed pickups.

uniquejumps.label: Unique Jumps
uniquejumps.description: Unique stunt bonuses detected from the center-screen completion banner.

offroadmissions.label: Off-road Challenges
offroadmissions.description: Patriot Playground, A Ride in the Park, Gripped!, and Multistorey Mayhem.

rcmissions.label: RC Toyz Missions
rcmissions.description: The four RC Toyz destruction missions.

importexport.label: Import / Export Lists
importexport.description: Portland garage, Shoreside Vale garage, and emergency-vehicle crane lists.

vehicledeliveries.label: Import / Export Vehicles
vehicledeliveries.description: Aggregate vehicle deliveries detected from the generic delivery message. The notification does not identify the vehicle, so exact list membership remains a manual checklist.
vehicledeliveries.requirement: Deliver 39 vehicles across the Portland, Shoreside Vale, and emergency-vehicle lists.

taxifares.label: Taxi Fares
taxifares.description: Taxi Driver fares; these do not need to be consecutive.

firefighter.label: Firefighter Fires
firefighter.description: Twenty extinguished fires on each island.

vigilante.label: Vigilante Kills
vigilante.description: Twenty criminal kills on each island.

paramedic.label: Paramedic Level
paramedic.description: Highest Paramedic level completed in one continuous attempt.

routesignals.label: OCR Route Signals
routesignals.description: Internal mission-title markers used to advance practice splits without claiming a mission is complete.
